item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p = Path('payment-sent.svg')
root = ET.parse(p).getroot()
assert root.tag == '{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg'
assert 'infinite' not in p.read_text()
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in p.read_text()
print(f'Validated SVG XML: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; one-shot animation with reduced-motion fallback.')
PY"
